# Clock is shared but only we see it

`customer_support.mm.sla_management.clock_is_shared_but_only_we_see_it` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> The clock is a shared object that only one party can see.

We hold the instrument and the customer holds the expectation. Everything good in SLA communication follows from deliberately showing them our side of it — a stated deadline, a stated pause, a stated miss — and everything bad follows from assuming they can infer it.
